decisions.reason: As a low-cost accessory with a small carrying cost, the option to keep it on the market remains valuable while its complement to trailers may still generate demand.
The box car trailer series is a core product line promoted on the home page, and its option value likely remains positive given the firm's passenger car transport focus.
The car transporter trailer directly serves the passenger car transport market, but its own-page promotion suggests moderate commitment and some uncertainty, so keeping the option is justified.
The low-bed trailer series is outside the firm's passenger car focus, carries high resource costs, and with many other options available, its option value has likely resolved unfavorably.
The high trailer cover series is a low-cost accessory that complements existing trailers, and keeping this option alive costs little while uncertainty remains.
As a duplicate box car trailer series, it creates redundancy among the firm's many product options, and resources can be better allocated to more distinct offerings.
